sources.title: Wikidata Q1049632 (Prospect Park) and its features: Q106694860 Prospect Park Lake, Q4931524 Prospect Park Boathouse, Q6647480 Litchfield Villa

heightM.note: the villa's tower top above the park, proportioned by eye

treeLowM.note: the lower canopy height of the tree masses

treeHighM.note: the upper canopy height (below the villa tower)

treeSpacingM.note: canopy mound spacing at the finest level at density 1

longMeadowNorth.note: the Long Meadow's northern half, by eye

longMeadowNorthAxes.note: its semi-axes, the long one running south-south-west

longMeadowSouth.note: the Long Meadow's southern half, by eye

longMeadowHeadingDeg.note: the compass heading of the Long Meadow's long axis

nethermead.note: the Nethermead, the park's middle meadow, by eye

lake.note: Prospect Park Lake's middle, by eye (Wikidata Q106694860 gives no point)

lakeAxes.note: semi-axes of an ellipse of the lake's Wikidata area (60 acres, P2046), the long axis east-north-east

lakeHeadingDeg.note: the compass heading of the lake's long axis

lullwater.note: the Lullwater, the narrow water from the boathouse down to the lake, by eye

lullwaterAxes.note: its semi-axes, the long one north-south

boathouse.note: Prospect Park Boathouse (Q4931524, P625): a generic pale pavilion and terrace over the water

boathouse2.note: the boathouse terrace's width and depth

villa.note: Litchfield Villa (Q6647480, P625): a generic villa with a square tower

lampSpacingM.note: lamps along the drive at the finest level

drive0.note: loop drive point 0: north, near Grand Army Plaza (by eye)

drive1.note: loop drive point 1: west side (by eye)

drive3.note: loop drive point 3: west of the lake (by eye)

drive4.note: loop drive point 4: south-west of the lake (by eye)

drive5.note: loop drive point 5: south of the lake (by eye)

drive6.note: loop drive point 6: east of the lake (by eye)

drive7.note: loop drive point 7: east side (by eye)

readabilityScale.note: Structures are drawn twice their real plan and the drive twice its width so they read at game distance; lamps three times a lamp head.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.8; the plan stays the map's park outline (x1.0); structures and the drive take the readability scale.
